summary: Worked the quit-vs-stay job conflict. One part wanted to resign immediately; a terrified part froze at the idea of no income. The terrified part got quieter after a slow body scan. The Critic spiked once around 'you'll fail either way' and settled after John named it out loud.
what_shifted: The terrified part got quieter after the body scan; John left calmer than he arrived.
open_thread: John agreed to notice which part speaks first when the Sunday-night dread hits, and bring that observation back.
